transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
My sinuses are all stuffed up.
When did you first notice your sinuses getting stuffed up?
I was diagnosed with diabetes last fall.
Do you have any allergies?
No, not that I know of.
How much is the stuffiness in your sinuses getting in the way of your daily activities?
I still walk a mile or two most days.
Did your sinus stuffiness start suddenly, come on gradually, or are you not sure?
It's been going on for several days now.
Have you made any changes to your medicines recently?
No, nothing's changed that I know of.
Would you say the stuffiness in your sinuses feels mild, moderate, or severe — or are you not sure?
I haven't really noticed it being that bad.
Have you noticed any other symptoms along with your sinus stuffiness?
No stomach upset or anything like that.
Have you noticed anything that seems to make your sinus stuffiness better or worse?
My granddaughter came by last weekend. Not sure about the sinuses.
Does the stuffiness in your sinuses come and go, or is it there all the time?
It's just kind of there, I guess.
Besides the diabetes you mentioned, is there anything else about your past health you'd like to add?
I check my feet every day.
When you think about your health these days, what worries you the most?
I feel well overall, so not much worries me.
Is there anything else about your past health, besides diabetes, that you'd like to add?
I don't smoke, never have.
Do you take any medicines, and if so, which ones, including any new or changed ones?
I can't remember the names, sorry.
Besides the stuffed-up sinuses, is there anything else going on with you that you've noticed?
I get up once a night to pee.
Is there anything else about your past health, such as any operations, that you'd like to add?
No operations that I recall.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about your medicines?
No, that's all I can think of.
Is there anything else you’ve noticed along with the stuffed-up sinuses that you’d like to add?
My ankles aren't swollen or anything.
How much are your stuffed-up sinuses bothering you right now: a little, somewhat, or a lot, or you're not sure?
Just a little, I'd say.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
